name.en: The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor
name.ja: お<ruby>返<rt>かえ</rt></ruby>し<ruby>鶴<rt>つる</rt></ruby><ruby>秘<rt>ひ</rt></ruby><ruby>姫<rt>め</rt></ruby>

text.en: During your opponent's End Phase: You can place this card from your GY on top of the Deck. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can return this card from the field to the hand, and if you do, each player draws 1 card, then your opponent can draw 1 card, and if they do, you must keep your hand revealed during this Main Phase. (Quick Effect): You can banish this revealed card from your hand; destroy all face-up cards your opponent controls. You can only use each effect of "The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor" once per turn.
text.zh-CN:
此卡名的①②③效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：在对手的结束阶段可以发动。将墓地的此卡放回牌组最上面。②：在自己・对手的主要阶段可以发动。将场上的此卡放回手牌，双方各抽1张。然后，对手可适用以下效果。
●自己抽1张，此主要阶段中，对手持续公开所有手牌。
③：在自己・对手回合中，将手牌中被公开的此卡除外可以发动。将对手场上的表侧表示卡全部破坏。
